tags.name: Resilience
tags.description:
Resilience exposes the high-availability state of the proxies (circuit breaker status and effective
settings) and manages automatic failover policies and the history of performed failovers.

tags.name: Webhook
tags.description:
Webhook service receives storage events and enqueues replication tasks.
Returns non-200 only on transient errors (context cancelled, Redis
unavailable) where a retry may succeed. Permanent errors (unknown storage,
invalid events, no replication policy) are logged server-side and return 200.

post.summary:
Schedules downtime window to switch source<->destination replication
targets. See SwitchDowntimeOpts for downtime scheduling options.
Can be edited if downtime window has not started yet.
post.description:
During downtime window all requests to replication target are blocked on
tutti proxy. When all replication tasks are processed, tutti can perform
optional data equality check and complete the switch. On completion, proxy
unblocks requests to target and routes all requests to destination target.

Unlike zero-downtime switch, downtime switch can perform optional data
equality check and rollback to source target without data loss.
Requirements:
  - replication must exist
  - replication must be proxy-based (agent replication is not supported)
  - for bucket-level replication, from/to bucket names must be the same
  - switch is not started. Use DeleteBucketSwitch in this case.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
Request to configure switch between replication source and destination
with downtime window.

post.summary:
Deletes Switch with following implications:
!!!Use with caution for ZeroDowntime switch.
post.description:
- [OK] If switch was in not_started, error, or skipped state, it will not
be attempted anymore. Routing will not be affected.
- If switch was in_progress, it will be aborted:
     * [OK] For downtime switch, block will be removed and proxy will
     route all requests to source target, no data will be lost.
     * [WARN] For ZeroDowntime switch, routing will be reverted back to
     source target. Meaning that targets may end up in inconsistent state
     because some writes were already routed to destination target.
- [OK] If switch was done. Only switch metadata will be removed,
replication or routing will not be affected.

post.summary:
Switches source<->destination replication targets without downtime.
Zero-downtime switch will take effect immediately on tutti proxy:
- all writes will be now routed to replication destination
- all reads will be routed to target with latest data
When all replication tasks will be processed, switch will be completed and
all reads and writes will be routed to destination target only.
post.description:
Unlike switch with downtime, zero-downtime switch is not checking bucket
contents on completion and cannot be aborted or reverted without risk of
data loss.
Requirements for zero-downtime switch:
  - replication must exist
  - replication must be proxy-based (agent replication is not supported)
  - for bucket-level replication, from/to bucket names must be the same
  - no existing switch must exist for given replication. Zero downtime
  switch cannot be updated. Use DeleteBucketSwitch in this case.

get.summary:
GetProxyStatus returns all live proxy instances with the health of their storages and effective settings.
Proxies publish their status periodically; an instance that stopped publishing disappears after a short TTL.

ListProxyAccounts returns the accounts able to authenticate against live proxies (users of storage credentials
used by the proxy and custom credentials) with their effective access policy. Secrets are never returned.
Runtime-managed ("dynamic") accounts are listed with source "dynamic" and their lifecycle metadata.

post.summary:
CreateProxyAccount creates a runtime-managed proxy account for an existing storage user and returns the
generated access key id and secret. The secret is returned ONLY in this response.
Fails with FailedPrecondition if the dynamic credentials master password is not configured.

put.summary: DeleteProxyAccount permanently removes a dynamic account.

RotateProxyAccountSecret generates a new secret. The previous secret keeps working for grace_period.
The new secret is returned ONLY in this response.
SetProxyAccountStatus enables ("active") or disables ("disabled") a dynamic account.

get.summary: GetProxyFleetConfig returns the centralized proxy fleet configuration (cluster defaults + per-group overrides).

put.summary: SetProxyFleetConfig updates the centralized proxy fleet configuration and bumps its version.

get.summary:
GetStatsHistory returns the traffic rates of all proxies over the last `range` (5m, 15m, 1h or 6h), summed
across proxies per time bucket (10s; 30s for 1h; 2m for 6h), plus the latest rates of every proxy.
Proxies record a sample every 10s into Redis (kept 6h), so history survives UI reloads.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: One of "5m", "15m", "1h", "6h". Default "15m".

parameters.name: includeUsers
parameters.description:
Default true (unset): each storage embeds its users. false: users is omitted and only user_count is set, which keeps
the call cheap with many users.

put.summary:
RotateStorageConnectionAccount replaces the connection account of a storage: the new account is tested first,
then switched atomically. The previous account is kept (sealed) so that proxies that have not polled yet keep working.

post.summary:
TestStorageConnection runs the connection checks of the scale plan (2.4) against unsaved settings (storage +
connection_account) or an existing storage (name). It never fails because a check failed: the failing steps are in
the result. Results of existing storages are stored with the storage (last_test).

get.summary: GetRuntimeStorage returns one storage with its connection account (never the secret) and the last connection test.
GetSystemSettings returns dynamic cluster features, worker performance tuning, and operational parameters.

put.summary: UpdateSystemSettings updates dynamic cluster features, worker performance tuning, and operational parameters.

get.summary: Scopes with a replication from a storage that has neither an enabled legacy failover policy nor a group.

ListS3Users returns the union of all users across storages with the credential state per storage (never the
secret), the proxy access key counts and the access policy summary.

post.summary:
CreateS3User creates a user with dynamic credentials on the given storages (the main storage is required),
optionally verifying them first, setting an access policy and creating the first proxy access key.
Fails with FailedPrecondition if dynamic credentials are not enabled. Partial changes are rolled back.

put.summary:
UpdateS3UserCredentials sets or replaces the dynamic credentials of an existing user on one storage.
Credentials defined in the worker config cannot be changed (FailedPrecondition).

DeleteS3UserCredentials removes the dynamic per-user credentials (override) of a user on one storage; the user
then falls back to the storage connection account. Admin only. FailedPrecondition if the credentials come from
config, or if the user would be left without credentials on a storage without connection account while
replications, routings or failover events reference the user.

DeleteS3User removes the dynamic credentials, dynamic proxy access keys and the access policy of a user.
Refused with FailedPrecondition (listing all reasons) if any credentials come from config or if replications,
routings or failover events reference the user. Active access keys also block deletion unless force is set.

post.summary:
TestS3UserCredentials checks credentials against one storage with a ListBuckets call.
Uses the given credentials or, if not given, the stored credentials of the user.

get.summary:
GetWorkerStats returns the replication throughput snapshots published by the live worker processes
(every 5s, TTL 20s) plus their aggregated totals.

post.summary:
S3Notifications receives standard AWS S3 notification events and enqueues
replication tasks. Compatible with S3 bucket notification push format.
Events that cannot be processed are skipped and logged server-side.

parameters.name: storage
parameters.description: Tutti storage alias (must be a configured S3 storage). Bound to URL path.

post.summary:
SwiftEvents receives a batch of OpenStack Swift events parsed from
access logs by an external log exporter (e.g. Fluent Bit, Vector)
and enqueues replication tasks for events matching active policies.
Events that cannot be processed are skipped and logged server-side.

Events are processed independently; a failure in one does not affect others.

tuttiEventSource.description:
Determines how ongoing data change events are captured for replication.

 - EVENT_SOURCE_PROXY: Default. Events captured by tutti proxy intercepting S3/Swift API calls.
 - EVENT_SOURCE_S3_NOTIFICATION: S3 bucket notifications. Worker creates SNS topic + bucket notification
pointing to its own webhook endpoint. Bucket-level replication only.
 - EVENT_SOURCE_WEBHOOK: External event source (e.g. Swift access log exporter).
Requires webhook to be enabled in worker config. No automatic setup.

bucket.description: Bucket whose routing was switched. Empty for a user-level failover.

eventLag.description: Number of unreplicated events at failover time.

bucket.description: Bucket of the event. Empty for a user-level event.

enabled.description: True to allow the proxy to fail over automatically. An enabled policy needs at least one target.

targets.description: Only storages that may be promoted, in order of preference. Must be configured and differ from the source.

after.description: How long the source breaker must be continuously open. Unset or zero means the proxy default.

maxEventLag.description: Max number of unreplicated events allowed on the replication to the target. Unset means the proxy default.

tuttiFailoverPolicy.description: FailoverPolicy defines which storages may be promoted when the source storage is down.

enabled.description: True if the automatic failover controller runs in this proxy.

checkInterval.description: How often the controller evaluates failover conditions.

after.description: Default time the source breaker must be continuously open, for policies that omit it.

maxEventLag.description: Default max unreplicated events allowed, for policies that omit it.

tuttiFailoverSettings.description: FailoverSettings are the effective failover controller defaults of a proxy.

openDuration.description: How long an open breaker rejects requests before one trial is allowed.

tuttiHealthSettings.description: HealthSettings are the effective circuit breaker settings of a proxy.

sumSeconds.description: Sum of all durations in seconds (average = sum_seconds / count).

boundsSeconds.description: Inclusive upper bounds of the buckets in seconds.

buckets.description: Non-cumulative bucket counts: len(bounds_seconds)+1 items, the last one is the +Inf bucket.

tuttiLatencyHistogram.description: LatencyHistogram is a fixed-bucket histogram of full request durations.

hideUserReplications.description: if true, user-level replications will be excluded from response.

hideBucketReplications.description: if true, bucket-level replications will be excluded from response.

hideSwitchInfo.description: if true, replications will be listed without switch info.

filter.description: OPTIONAL: filter to apply to replications list.

user.description: If set, filters replications by exact user.

fromStorage.description: If set, filters replications by exact source storage.

toStorage.description: If set, filters replications by exact destination storage.

fromBucket.description: If set, filters bucket-level replications by exact source bucket.

toBucket.description: If set, filters bucket-level replications by exact destination bucket.

isArchived.description: If set, filters replications by archived status.

isPaused.description: If set, filters replications by paused status.

isInitDone.description: If set, filters replications by completion of initial replication phase.

hasSwitch.description: If set, filters replications that have or not have associated switch.

statuses.description: Same objects as Get returns, in the same order as groups, computed in one batched pass.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Set while a rotated-out secret is still valid.

tuttiProxyAccessKey.description: ProxyAccessKey describes one runtime-managed access key (never its secret).

policy.description: Effective policy: the stored one, or read-write on all buckets if none is stored.

hasPolicy.description: True if a policy is stored for the user.

dynamicKeys.description:
Runtime-managed access keys of the user with lifecycle metadata. Their ids are also in access_key_ids
and "dynamic" is in sources.

tuttiProxyAccount.description: ProxyAccount is a proxy user with its access key ids and effective policy.

dynamicAccounts.description: Whether CreateProxyAccount can work at all.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Set after a rotation with a grace period: until then the previous secret still works.

tuttiProxyAccountSecret.description: ProxyAccountSecret is returned once, when a secret is generated.

tuttiProxyLatestRates.description: ProxyLatestRates is the most recent history sample of one proxy.

requireSignedContentType.description: True if SigV4 requests without a signed Content-Type header are rejected.

readHeaderTimeout.description: Max time to read HTTP request headers (non-hot-reloadable; changing requires proxy restart).

writerLease.description: Protection group writer lease TTL (non-hot-reloadable; changing requires proxy restart).

tuttiProxySettings.description: ProxySettings are the effective settings of a proxy.

appId.description: Unique id of the proxy instance.

updatedAt.description: Time of the last status update.

storages.description: Health of every storage, as seen by this proxy.

stats.description:
Built-in traffic statistics (no Prometheus needed). Absent for proxies that do not publish them.
Counters are cumulative since stats.started_at: compute rates from two snapshots with the same
started_at (a changed started_at means the proxy restarted and counters were reset).

rates.description:
Current rates computed by the proxy over a sliding window of ~10s (no need to diff two snapshots).
Absent for proxies that do not publish them. Settings.failover tells whether the failover controller runs.

appliedConfigVersion.description: Central fleet configuration version applied by this proxy.

pendingRestart.description: True when central fleet configuration changed a setting that requires a proxy restart.

pendingRestartReasons.description: Names of settings that require a proxy restart to take effect.

configError.description:
Set when the latest central fleet configuration was rejected by this proxy (invalid document or effective
settings); the proxy keeps running on the last good configuration (applied_config_version).

tuttiProxyStatus.description: ProxyStatus is the status of one live proxy instance.

proxies.description: Live proxy instances sorted by app id.

totalRates.description: Current rates summed across the listed proxies (latency: request-weighted average, p95: maximum).

configVersion.description: Latest central proxy fleet configuration version (0 when no central config was saved yet).

isInitDone.description:
true if initial replication phase is done.
Initial phase copies all data existing in source at the moment of
replication creation.

initObjListed.description:
Approximate number of objects listed during initial replication.
Corresponds to total number of tasks created for initial replication queue.

initObjDone.description:
Approximate number of objects processed during initial replication.
Corresponds to total number of tasks completed from initial replication
queue.

events.description:
Number of source data change events captured and queued for replication.
Corresponds to total number of tasks created for event replication queue.

eventsDone.description:
Number of source data change events synced to destination.
Corresponds to total number of tasks completed from event replication
queue.

eventLag.description:
Approximate time lag for syncing events to destination.
Corresponds to age of the oldest unprocessed task in event replication
queue (aka replication queue latency).

isArchived.description:
true if replication is archived. Archived replication will not generate or
sync new events. The main purpose of archived replication is to keep
replication metadata for future reference. Archived replication can be
safely deleted.

switchInfo.description: If replication has associated switch, contains its status info.

eventSource.description: How ongoing data change events are captured for this replication.

webhookUrl.description:
Webhook endpoint URL for this replication (if event source uses webhook).
Read-only, computed by the server.

tuttiReplication.description:
Represents specification and status of user-level or bucket-level
replication.

user.description:
Replication user from tutti storage credential config; must be configured
for both from/to storages. Empty means storage-level replication: both
storages must have a connection account.

fromStorage.description: REQUIRED: source storage name from tutti storage config.

toStorage.description:
REQUIRED: destination storage name from tutti storage config.
Can be equal to from_storage if both from/to buckets are set and different.

fromBucket.description:
OPTIONAL: source bucket name.
For user-level replication, this field must be empty.
For bucket-level replication, this field must be set.

toBucket.description:
OPTIONAL: destination bucket name.
For user-level replication, this field must be empty.
For bucket-level replication, this field must be set. From/to buckets can
be different.

tuttiReplicationID.description:
Represents user-level and bucket-level replication source and destination
targets.
- User-level replicates all existing and future buckets of the user.
- Bucket-level  replicates a single bucket.

eventSource.description: Determines how ongoing data change events are captured.

tuttiReplicationOpts.description: Additional replication options for bucket and user-level replications.

onEventError.description: Behavior when the replication event cannot be recorded: "fail" or "log".

eventRetryBudget.description: Total time to retry recording the replication event.

tuttiReplicationSettings.description: ReplicationSettings are the effective replication settings of a proxy.

zeroDowntime.title: true if switch is zero downtime

multipartTtl.title: multipart uploads TTL for zero downtime switch

lastStartedAt.description:
Time of last switch attempt - last time when switch was moved to InProgress
status.

doneAt.description: Time of last switch completion. Set only if switch status is Done.

tuttiReplicationSwitchStatus.description:
- NOT_STARTED: Switch is not started yet
 - IN_PROGRESS: Switch is in progress. Draining replication events queue.
For switch with downtime, requests to target are blocked at this point.
 - CHECK_IN_PROGRESS: Switch is in progress. Queue is drained. Checking if source and
destination targets are the same. Requests are still blocked. Used only
for switch with downtime with enabled bucket check.
 - ERROR: Switch failed to complete in downtime window and was aborted.
Requests to target are unblocked. Used only for switch with downtime.
If cron downtime_window is used, switch will be retried on next cron
execution.
 - SKIPPED: Switch was not able to start in given downtime window because conditions
were not met. Used only for switch with downtime. If cron downtime_window
is used, switch will be retried on next cron execution.
 - DONE: Switch was successfully completed.
All data was replicated to replication destination target and all read
and all requests are now routed to it.

gracePeriod.description: How long the previous secret keeps working. Unset means 1h, zero means immediate invalidation.

force.description: Switch although the test has failing steps.

hideUserRoutings.title: set true to hide user-level routings from response

hideBucketRoutings.title: set true to hide bucket-level routings from response

filter.title: optional filter to apply to routings list

user.title: filter routing policy by user (exact match)

bucket.title: filter routing policy by bucket (exact match)

toStorage.title: filter routing policy by destination storage (exact match)

isBlocked.title: filter routing policy by blocked status

main.description:
name of the main storage - default destination if not overridden by user or
bucket routing.

connectionAccount.description: Connection account of the storage (never the secret). configured=false: legacy per-user credentials only.

lastTest.description: Result of the last connection test (on save, on demand or the periodic re-check of steps 1-5).

lastForcedSaveBy.description: Set when the storage was saved although the test had failing steps (force).

legacyCredentials.description: True if the storage has no connection account: it only works with per-user credentials.

userCount.description: Number of users with their own credentials on the storage. Always filled by ListRuntimeStorages.

tuttiRuntimeStorage.description: RuntimeStorage contains connection settings and metadata, never credentials secrets.

configurationId.description: Encoded tutti notification ID (contains user + bucket).

storages.description: One entry for every configured storage.

complete.description: True if every S3 storage can be resolved for the user: an override or a connection account on each storage.

static.description: Keys of the user defined by config (storage credentials and custom auth) reported by live proxies.

dynamicCredentialsEnabled.description: True if users can be created and changed at runtime.

permission.description: Effective permission: the stored one or "read-write".

configured.description: True if the user has credentials on this storage.

accessKeyId.description: Never the secret. Empty for mode "connection-account" and "missing".

mode.description:
How the proxy and the worker sign requests of this user to the storage: "override" (per-user credentials),
"connection-account" (the storage connection account) or "missing" (requests fail with 503).

tuttiS3UserStorage.description: S3UserStorage is the credential state of an S3 user on one storage.

expectedVersion.description:
expected_version is the config version the caller loaded. When set and different from the stored version the
update is rejected with FailedPrecondition. Unset skips the check.

points.description: Ascending by time; buckets without any sample are omitted.

proxies.description: Latest sample of every proxy that recorded one within the range.

tuttiStatsHistoryPoint.description: StatsHistoryPoint is one time bucket with the rates summed across all proxies.

name.title: some human-readable alias for storage config

available.description: True while the circuit breaker is closed.

lastError.description: Last availability error, empty if none.

lastChange.description: Time of the last breaker state change.

tuttiStorageHealth.description: StorageHealth is the circuit breaker state of one storage as seen by one proxy.

probeBucketPrefix.description:
Prefix of the temporary probe bucket. Default "tutti-probe-". Use e.g. "app-tutti-probe-" when the account policy
is limited to a bucket prefix.

probeBucket.description: Existing bucket to use instead of creating one (when bucket creation is not allowed). The bucket is not deleted.

features.description: Features to check in steps 13/14. Unset: versioning if the provider supports it, no others.

leftovers.description: Probe buckets/objects that could not be removed.

kind.description: "full" (all steps) or "periodic" (steps 1-5, run by the health checker).

number.description: Step number of the plan table (1-17).

container.description: Required for container and object operations.

date.description:
Optional. Server response date, used as reference timestamp when
Swift does not return Last-Modified (account/container/meta updates).

deleteMultipart.description: Optional. If true, indicates SLO/DLO multipart manifest deletion.

tuttiSwiftOperation.description:
SwiftOperation determines which replication task is created.
Task handlers are idempotent — e.g. CONTAINER_UPDATE and CONTAINER_DELETE
both trigger a sync that compares source and destination state.

startOnInitDone.title:
If true, tutti will perform switch automatically when initial migration
will be done. Initial migration copies all objects that existed in source
bucket before replication started. default is false

cron.description:
If set, tutti will try or retry to start downtime window according to CRON
schedule.
It is not makes sense to set cron frequency less than one hour or less than
max_duration if used. Either cron or start_at can be set, but not both.

startAt.description:
If set, downtime window will be attempted at given time only once.
If at this point initial migration will not be done, switch will be marked
as failed and not executed. Either cron or start_at can be set, not both.

maxDuration.description:
If set, tutti will abort downtime window if it will not be able to
complete in given time. In this case, switch will be marked as failed and
will be retried on next cron execution if set.

maxEventLag.description:
If set, switch execution will be skipped if number of unprocessed events is
more than max_event_lag. Switch will be marked as failed and will be
retried on next cron execution if set.

skipBucketCheck.description:
if true, tutti will not perform equality check of target contents before
completing switch with downtime. Might be useful for buckets with large
number of objects. In this case check will consume a lot of time and memory
in Redis. Default is false.

continueReplication.description:
Set true to replicate data updates from new main to old main bucket after
successful switch. Default is false.

tuttiSwitchDowntimeOpts.description:
Defines downtime window for replication switch with downtime.
All dates and times depends on local times of machine running tutti worker.
Time precision is ~1 minute.

replicationId.description:
Id of user- or bucket- level replication policy to switch source and
destination targets on proxy. Replication policy should already exist.
Agent-based replication is not supported.
Bucket-level replication with different from/to bucket names is not
supported.

downtimeOpts.description:
Configures downtime window for switch. During downtime all requests to
target will be blocked on proxy. If options are not set, downtime will be
started right away and will last until all replication tasks are processed.

tuttiSwitchDowntimeRequest.description:
Request to configure switch between replication source and destination
with downtime window.

replicationId.description:
Id of user- or bucket- level replication policy to switch source and
destination targets on proxy. Replication policy should already exist.
Agent-based replication is not supported.
Bucket-level replication with different from/to bucket names is not
supported.

multipartTtl.description:
Max Amount of time to wait for uncompleted multipart uploads to finish
before switching targets. Default is 1 hour.

enabled.description: True if objects are copied to destinations before answering the client.

writeQuorum.description: Number of copies (main included) required before answering. 0 means main plus all destinations.

timeout.description: Max time spent syncing destinations per request.

onQuorumFailure.description: Behavior when the quorum is not reached: "fail" responds 503, "accept" forwards the main response.

tuttiSyncSettings.description: SyncSettings are the effective synchronous replication settings of a proxy.

bulkConcurrencyPercent.description: Share of concurrency given to bulk migration: 0 = default (20) or 5..95. Read at worker start only.

multipartThreads.description: Parallel parts per multipart upload: 0 = default (1) or 1..16. Applied live to the next copy.

multipartPartSizeMib.description: Multipart part size in MiB: 0 = default (16) or 5..512. Applied live to the next copy.

routeToStorage.description: destination storage name according to current routing configuration.

isBlocked.description: true if requests are blocked for given user and bucket.

replications.description: list of applicable replications for given user and bucket.

credential.description: Credentials to test. If not set, the stored credentials of the user are used.

name.description: Existing storage name. Alternatively give storage settings (and a connection_account) for an unsaved storage.

connectionAccount.description: For an existing storage: test this account instead of the stored one (does not change the stored account).

windowSeconds.description: Time span the rates were computed over (0 right after proxy start).

requestsByClass.description: Requests/s by operation class: read, write, exists, manage, other.

requestsByStorage.description: Requests/s by the storage they were routed to.

latencyAvgMs.description: Mean request duration in the window. When summed over proxies: request-weighted average.

latencyP95Ms.description:
95th percentile estimated from histogram deltas. When combined over proxies or buckets: the MAXIMUM of the
parts (an upper bound), because percentiles cannot be merged exactly.

tuttiTrafficRates.description: TrafficRates are per-second traffic rates over a short window. Latencies are in milliseconds.

startedAt.description: Time the counters started (proxy process start).

requestsByClass.description: Requests by operation class: read, write, exists, manage, other.

requestsByStorage.description: Requests by the storage they were routed to (requests rejected before routing are not included).

failFast.description: Requests rejected immediately because the storage circuit breaker is open.

accessDenied.description: Requests denied by an access policy.

eventRecordFailed.description: Requests answered 503 because the replication event could not be recorded.

syncBelowQuorum.description: Synchronous replication: fewer copies than the write quorum.

syncSkipped.description: Synchronous replication enabled but nothing to replicate synchronously for the request.

noCredentials.description: Requests failed with 503 because the storage has no credentials for the user (no override, no connection account).

tuttiTrafficStats.description:
TrafficStats are cumulative in-memory traffic counters of one proxy instance.
For per-replication backlog (events, events_done, event_lag) use Policy/ListReplications.

bucket.description: bucket whose routing to change. Empty for the user-level routing.

connectionAccount.description: Unset keeps the current connection account. Use RotateStorageConnectionAccount to replace a working account.

clearConnectionAccount.description: Remove the connection account (back to legacy per-user credentials).

verify.description: Check the credentials with a ListBuckets call before saving.

user.description: overrides routing destination for all requests of given user.

toStorage.title:
destination storage name
can be empty if routing is blocked

isBlocked.title: true if routing is blocked for given user
